accounting-gap (LDO): the paper's 180 mW is the LDO *block* dissipation, and the deck carries it as a constant-power sink.  The deck's own terms inside the path are two disjoint branches, the pass element (V(vin)-V(vreg)) x I_load = 4.3121 mW and R_OUT (V(vreg)-V(vout)) x I_load = 0.002644 mW, summing to a self-built 4.3148 mW, so the modelled regulator path is 184.3148 mW (VIN - load), which is 2.4 % above the published block anchor.  The extra term is a model loss, not published and not measured, and the two figures must not be conflated; the full supply chain (coil -> rectifier -> DC link -> LDO -> MCU) is unverified.
model-gap (EM): no full-wave solver available - coupling coefficient k, induced EMF and SAR are not computed.
